violation_type.code_system: Texas Administrative Code, Title 26, Ch. HRC42
violation_type.title: HRC42.052(d) - AP Illegal Operation - Not Registered (26 TAC §HRC42.052(d) - AP Illegal Operation - No)
violation_type.short_title: HRC42.052(d) - AP Illegal Operation - Not Registered
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on information obtained during the investigation, the provider provides child care services to four (4) unrelated children in her home without the appropriate child care permit.

finding_variants.text: Based on information obtained during the investigation, the provider provides child care services to four (4) unrelated children in her home without the appropriate child care permit.
Throughout the course of the investigation, inspectors have observed at least four unrelated children in care.
Based on the information obtained from the investigation, it was determined that the homeowner is subject to regulation.
During the investigation inspection it was found that the operation was caring for 11 unrelated children in the home without a permit.
